neighbours.label: describing a substance's physical look and smell: 'less' in colorless and odorless, ' white' to off-white solid, as opposed to -less words about people and ' white' for ordinary objects
fire: Methane is a colourless, flammable and odorless gas.
Pure ethanol is a clear, colorless liquid with a sharp smell.
The compound is a white to pale yellow crystalline powder.
This salt is an odourless solid that dissolves in water.
Nitrogen is colorless and makes up most of the air.
The oil is tasteless, odorless and safe to eat.
Sucralose is a white, odorless powder used as a sweetener.
Radon is an invisible and odorless radioactive gas.
quiet: The widow felt powerless, friendless and useless after the war.
Pure nonsense, a thoughtless, reckless remark with a sharp tone.
The cottage is a white to pale yellow painted building.
This puppy is a fearless animal that runs into the water.
The soldier was penniless and lost most of his friends.
The joke was tactless, heartless and cruel to hear.
Snow White is a beloved princess in a children's story.
Our cat is a restless and sleepless little creature.
